source.credit: Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory Star Catalog (1966), ADC corrections through 1991; USNO FK5 J2000 astrometry; HEASARC, NASA/GSFC

derivation.raMotion: Original seconds of time/year multiplied by 15*cos(dec); TAP arcsec/year label is erroneous
derivation.photometry: Original heterogeneous visual magnitudes; ref_vmag/remarks retained; no Johnson V normalization, B-V, distance or guaranteed V=10 completeness
derivation.identity: Only explicit BSC SAO cross-identifications suppress added records; retain BSC component identities, never merge by HD or proximity
derivation.acquisitionTime: Not recorded by acquisition; retrievedAt remains null, never inferred from filesystem times
derivation.runtimeNetwork: No upstream queries; use a validated, separately versioned spatial publication
